<?php

namespace PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Writer\Xlsx;

use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\Functions;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\Coordinate;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper;

class FunctionPrefix
{
    const XLFNREGEXP = '/(?:_xlfn\.)?((?:_xlws\.)?('
            // functions added with Excel 2010
        . 'beta[.]dist'
        . '|beta[.]inv'
        . '|binom[.]dist'
        . '|binom[.]inv'
        . '|ceiling[.]precise'
        . '|chisq[.]dist'
        . '|chisq[.]dist[.]rt'
        . '|chisq[.]inv'
        . '|chisq[.]inv[.]rt'
        . '|chisq[.]test'
        . '|confidence[.]norm'
        . '|confidence[.]t'
        . '|covariance[.]p'

        . '|erf[.]precise'

        . '|lognorm[.]inv'
        . '|mode[.]mult'
        . '|mode[.]sngl'
        . '|negbinom[.]dist'
        . '|networkdays[.]intl'
        . '|norm[.]dist'
        . '|norm[.]inv'
        . '|norm[.]s[.]dist'
        . '|norm[.]s[.]inv'
        . '|percentile[.]exc'
        . '|percentile[.]inc'
        . '|percentrank[.]exc'
        . '|percentrank[.]inc'
        . '|poisson[.]dist'
        . '|quartile[.]exc'
        . '|quartile[.]inc'
        . '|rank[.]avg'
        . '|rank[.]eq'
        . '|stdev[.]p'
        . '|stdev[.]s'
        . '|t[.]dist'
        . '|t[.]dist[.]2t'
        . '|t[.]dist[.]rt'
        . '|t[.]inv'
        . '|t[.]inv[.]2t'
        . '|t[.]test'
        . '|var[.]p'
        . '|var[.]s'
        . '|weibull[.]dist'
        . '|z[.]test'
        // functions added with Excel 2013
        . '|acot'
        . '|acoth'
        . '|arabic'
        . '|averageifs'
        . '|binom[.]dist[.]range'
        . '|bitand'
        . '|bitlshift'
        . '|bitor'
        . '|bitrshift'
        . '|bitxor'
        . '|ceiling[.]math'
        . '|combina'
        . '|cot'
        . '|coth'
        . '|csc'
        . '|csch'
        . '|days'
        . '|dbcs'
        . '|decimal'
        . '|encodeurl'
        . '|filterxml'
        . '|floor[.]math'
        . '|formulatext'
        . '|gamma'
        . '|gauss'
        . '|ifna'
        . '|imcosh'
        . '|imcot'
        . '|imcsc'
        . '|imcsch'
        . '|imsec'
        . '|imsech'
        . '|imsinh'
        . '|imtan'
        . '|isformula'
        . '|iso[.]ceiling'
        . '|isoweeknum'
        . '|munit'
        . '|numbervalue'
        . '|pduration'
        . '|permutationa'
        . '|phi'
        . '|rri'
        . '|sec'
        . '|sech'
        . '|sheet'
        . '|sheets'
        . '|skew[.]p'
        . '|unichar'
        . '|unicode'
        . '|webservice'
        . '|xor'
        // functions added with Excel 2016
        . '|forecast[.]et2'
        . '|forecast[.]ets[.]confint'
        . '|forecast[.]ets[.]seasonality'
        . '|forecast[.]ets[.]stat'
        . '|forecast[.]linear'
        . '|switch'
        // functions added with Excel 2019
        . '|concat'
        . '|countifs'
        . '|ifs'
        . '|maxifs'
        . '|minifs'
        . '|sumifs'
        . '|textjoin'
        // functions added with Excel 365
        . '|filter'
        . '|randarray'
        . '|anchorarray'
        . '|sequence'
        . '|sort'
        . '|sortby'
        . '|unique'
        . '|xlookup'
        . '|xmatch'
        . '|arraytotext'
        . '|call'
        . '|let'
        . '|lambda'
        . '|single'
        . '|register[.]id'
        . '|textafter'
        . '|textbefore'
        . '|textsplit'
        . '|valuetotext'
        . '))\s*\(/Umui';

    const XLWSREGEXP = '/(?<!_xlws\.)('
        // functions added with Excel 365
        . 'filter'
        . '|sort'
        . ')\s*\(/mui';

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlfn. where required.
     */
    protected static function addXlfnPrefix(string $functionString): string
    {
        return (string) preg_replace(self::XLFNREGEXP, '_xlfn.$1(', $functionString);
    }

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlws. where required.
     */
    protected static function addXlwsPrefix(string $functionString): string
    {
        return (string) preg_replace(self::XLWSREGEXP, '_xlws.$1(', $functionString);
    }

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlfn. where required.
     */
    public static function addFunctionPrefix(string $functionString): string
    {
        $characterCount = StringHelper::countCharacters($functionString);
        $utf8Formula = StringHelper::sanitizeUTF8($functionString);
        if ($utf8Formula !== $functionString) {
            $utf8Formula = $functionString;
        }

        $leadingCharacter = StringHelper::substring($functionString, 0, 1);
        $parserInput = '=' . $functionString;
        if ($leadingCharacter === '=') {
            $parserInput = $functionString;
        }
        $parser = new FormulaParser($parserInput);
        $tokenCount = $parser->getTokenCount();
        $parsedFormula = $parser->getFormula();
        $parsedLength = StringHelper::countCharacters($parsedFormula);
        $parsedWithoutEquals = $parsedFormula;
        $parsedLead = StringHelper::substring($parsedFormula, 0, 1);
        if ($parsedLead === '=') {
            $parsedWithoutEquals = StringHelper::substring($parsedFormula, 1, max(0, $parsedLength - 1));
        }

        $inString = false;
        $inPath = false;
        $inRange = false;
        $inError = false;
        $index = 0;
        $buffer = '';
        $current = '';
        $errorLiteral = '';
        $parenDepth = 0;
        $functionCount = 0;
        $rangeCount = 0;
        $errorCount = 0;
        $formulaLength = strlen($functionString);
        $separators = FormulaParser::COMMA . FormulaParser::SEMICOLON . FormulaParser::WHITESPACE;
        $operators = FormulaParser::OPERATORS_INFIX . FormulaParser::OPERATORS_POSTFIX;

        while ($index < $formulaLength) {
            $char = $functionString[$index];
            $nextChar = substr($functionString, $index + 1, 1);

            if ($inString) {
                $buffer .= $char;
                if ($char === FormulaParser::QUOTE_DOUBLE) {
                    if ($nextChar === FormulaParser::QUOTE_DOUBLE) {
                        $buffer .= $nextChar;
                        ++$index;
                    } else {
                        $inString = false;
                    }
                }
                ++$index;
